backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented features, associated files, components, tests, and confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for key frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions implementing the red/white OKLCH color scheme.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component assembling hero, header, location, menu, and footer sections.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with restaurant info, contact, hours, and attribution.
frontend/src/components/HeaderSection.ts: Sticky header showing logo, names, and call/directions buttons.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner with background image, logo, titles, and prominent call button.
Location, contact, and hours displayed in three cards.
frontend/src/components/MenuSection.tsx: Menu grouped by category with pricing cards and popular badges.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and managing an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, exposing identity state, login, logout, and status helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty module exporting nothing since the backend has no query methods.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom red/white OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors from CSS variables, plugins, typography, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Describes project requirements and state for building a responsive restaurant website with a red/white theme, menu, location, and branding assets.
